title: A nonzerodivisor in a one-dimensional Noetherian local ring is only boundedly divisible by a parameter in finite extensions
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter chow.tex (Chow Homology), section preparing the key lemma
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file chow.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: The lemma states that in a one-dimensional Noetherian local ring with nonzerodivisors a, b and a in the maximal ideal, the exponent m such that b = a^m c can be realised inside a finite ring extension is bounded independently of the extension (statement lines 606-609). The proof produces the bound by leaving the ring: a discrete valuation ring A dominating a minimal quotient R/q records v(a) > 0, and the bound n = v(b)/v(a) is then shown to hold for every finite extension R contained in R' by propagating the picture along A tensor_R R', cutting down by a prime over (0) and comparing valuations in a further discrete valuation ring A''' dominating a localisation, where the relation b = a^m c forces v'''(b) >= m v'''(a) and v''' = e v (proof lines 613-638). The non-formal content is this chain of base changes preserving the divisibility relation while keeping control of the ramification. The claim is H2.
